You will partner closely with Sales, Product and Customer teams to strengthen our go-to-market strategy across our key markets, with a particular focus on accelerating growth in North America. AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
jobs.description:
AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in Netherlands.

As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems.
You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures.
Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.
Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents.
You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks.
Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization.
This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities.

  • Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems.

  • Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes.

  • Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking.

  • Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements.

  • Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment.

  • Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback.

  • Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

  • Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements.

  • Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong theoretical knowledge of reinforcement learning with hands-on experience developing and optimizing large-scale multimodal AI systems. The following qualifications and technical skills are expected:

    • Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. A PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, or a closely related field is preferred.

    • Strong track record of AI research, including publications in leading international conferences.

    • Demonstrated experience conducting large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online reinforcement learning environments.

    • Proven ability to improve domain-specific decision-making and achieve measurable gains in policy performance.

    • Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization techniques applied to vision and multimodal learning.

    • Strong knowledge of policy stability, exploration strategies, sample efficiency, and optimization in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities.

    • Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and modern deep learning frameworks for computer vision and multimodal AI.

    • Hands-on experience building end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines covering simulation, model training, evaluation, and production deployment.

    • Ability to address fundamental reinforcement learning challenges, including sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation trade-offs, and training instability.

    • Experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and using empirical research to continuously improve algorithmic performance.

    • Established research publication record at top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, or ECCV.

    • Strong analytical thinking, scientific problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate advanced research into practical AI solutions.

      • Benefits

      • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with a globally distributed team.

      • International Collaboration: Collaborate with talented researchers, engineers, and technology professionals across different countries and disciplines.

      • Cutting-Edge AI Research: Work on advanced reinforcement learning, multimodal architectures, generative AI, and next-generation intelligent systems.

      • Research and Innovation: Explore new methodologies and contribute to state-of-the-art developments in artificial intelligence.

      • Scientific Recognition: Opportunities to publish research and present findings at leading international AI and machine learning conferences.

      • Professional Growth: Develop expertise in emerging AI technologies while contributing to challenging, high-impact research initiatives.

      • Global Technology Environment: Be part of an ambitious, fast-growing organization working across AI, digital finance, peer-to-peer technology, and other innovative fields.

Accounts Payable Specialist

At i3D.net, we provide world-class global coverage with one of the most interconnected networks in the world. Our solutions focus on low latency, zero packet loss, and unmatched scalability, enabling seamless experiences for millions of users worldwide. With dedicated support, bespoke solutions, and cutting-edge technology, we deliver reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure that empowers game developers and businesses to scale effortlessly. Partnering with major names like Nvidia, DuckDuckGo, and Ubisoft, we are shaping the future of gaming and network technology.

Bij i3D.net bouwen we aan de toekomst van gaming en netwerktechnologie. Met een van de meest verbonden netwerken ter wereld bieden we internationale infrastructuuroplossingen voor miljoenen gebruikers. We combineren minimale vertraging, betrouwbare verbindingen en schaalbaarheid met persoonlijke ondersteuning en maatwerk. Zo helpen we gameontwikkelaars en bedrijven zoals NVIDIA, DuckDuckGo en Ubisoft om wereldwijd te groeien.

Ons Finance-team zorgt ervoor dat onze groeiende internationale organisatie ook financieel op rolletjes loopt. Daarom zoeken we een nauwkeurige, betrokken en proactieve Financieel Administratief Medewerker met een focus op Accounts Payable.

Jouw rol

Samen met je collega’s verzorg je de dagelijkse financiële administratie, met jouw focus op het crediteurenproces. Je zorgt dat inkoopfacturen correct worden verwerkt, tijdig worden goedgekeurd en volgens afspraak worden betaald.

Je bent een zichtbaar en toegankelijk aanspreekpunt binnen de organisatie. Je zoekt actief contact met collega’s, bewaakt de voortgang van factuurgoedkeuringen en volgt openstaande acties proactief op. Bij afwijkingen zoek je uit wat er speelt en werk je samen met leveranciers en collega’s aan een oplossing.

Daarnaast onderhoud je de workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee, het factuurverwerkingssysteem. Daarmee help je het factuurverwerkingsproces efficiënt en overzichtelijk te houden.

Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van acht collega’s en rapporteert aan de Finance Manager.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Controleren en boeken van inkoopfacturen op de juiste grootboekrekening en kostenplaats, met toepassing van de juiste btw-code.

  • Controleren of facturen aansluiten op contractuele afspraken en, waar van toepassing, inkooporders.

  • Bewaken van de voortgang van factuurgoedkeuringen en proactief opvolgen van openstaande acties bij collega’s.

  • Uitzoeken en oplossen van afwijkende, geblokkeerde of onvolledige facturen.

  • Onderhouden van workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee, in afstemming met de verantwoordelijke collega’s.

  • Voorbereiden van betaalvoorstellen en verwerken van betalingen volgens de interne autorisatieprocedure.

  • Verwerken van bankmutaties die betrekking hebben op leveranciersbetalingen.

  • Bijhouden en controleren van leveranciersgegevens volgens de afgesproken procedures.

  • Onderhouden van leverancierscontact over facturen, betalingen en openstaande vragen.

  • Controleren en afstemmen van openstaande crediteurenposten.

  • Ondersteunen bij de maand- en jaarafsluiting, onder meer door ontbrekende facturen en nog te verwerken kosten te signaleren.

  • Zorgen voor een volledige en controleerbare digitale administratie.

  • Signaleren van knelpunten en meedenken over verbeteringen in de financiële processen en systemen.

Hoe succes in het eerste jaar eruitziet

Je kent onze financiële processen en systemen en voert je dagelijkse werkzaamheden zelfstandig uit. Facturen worden correct verwerkt en tijdig ter goedkeuring en betaling aangeboden. Je houdt overzicht over openstaande posten en acties en schakelt tijdig wanneer de voortgang dreigt vast te lopen.

Collega’s weten je te vinden en jij weet wie je moet benaderen om zaken verder te brengen. De workflows en autorisatieschema’s in 4cee zijn actueel en je hebt bijgedragen aan een efficiënter factuurverwerkingsproces.

Tijdens de maand- en jaarafsluiting lever je de benodigde informatie tijdig en zorgvuldig aan.

Wie jij bent

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk. Je stelt prioriteiten, houdt overzicht en wacht niet af wanneer iets blijft liggen. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en spreekt collega’s op een prettige, duidelijke manier aan op openstaande acties.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, leert graag en denkt mee over hoe processen beter kunnen. Een internationale technische omgeving spreekt je aan en je vindt het leuk om vanuit Finance bij te dragen aan een organisatie in de wereld van gaming, infrastructuur en hosting.

  • Je hebt een afgeronde mbo-opleiding in een financiële richting en minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare financiële administratieve functie, bij voorkeur binnen de crediteurenadministratie.

  • Ervaring met verschillende btw-codes en het correct toepassen daarvan bij de verwerking van inkoopfacturen.

  • Praktische kennis van Excel en affiniteit met financiële systemen en digitale factuurverwerking.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels voor contact met collega’s en internationale leveranciers.

  • Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 24 uur per week, met ten minste twee vaste dagen op kantoor in Rotterdam.

  • Ervaring met NetSuite en 4cee is een pré.

Waarom werken bij i3D.net?

  • Maak het verschil:

  • Draag bij aan een solide financiële basis voor een internationaal bedrijf met een jarenlange staat van dienst.

  • Hybride werken

jobs.title: Senior Accountant (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Accountant (m/f/d)

**This position is based in Germany with remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Senior Accountant owns the end-to-end accounting for Chaos’s German entity, which is the main distributor of Chaos products worldwide. The role ensures full statutory compliance and timely financial reporting, and works closely with finance colleagues across the global business, combining technical accounting rigour with a process-improvement mindset so the business can move fast and operate at scale. This role requires an accountant with strong German GAAP and tax knowledge and experience in an international group.


Main Responsibilities

  • Own the full accounting cycle for Chaos Software GmbH, including general ledger, fixed assets, payroll postings, reconciliations, and monthly, quarterly and annual close, in line with German GAAP and group reporting requirements.

  • Act as the primary contact for external auditors, tax advisors and statutory filings.

  • Manage local treasury activity and payment cycles in coordination with the group finance team.

  • Prepare and submit all VAT returns and filings.

  • Define and maintain global standards for AP processes with teams across Chaos’s international entities, harmonising workflows, closing process gaps and driving automation in NetSuite and connected finance tools.

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate workflows, supporting the Accounting Director in building a culture of continuous improvement across finance.

  • Support accounting activities across the wider international group, including ad hoc projects as required.



  • 5 years of experience in financial accounting within an international corporate environment, ideally in a technology, software or SaaS business.

  • Experience working within an international group structure.

  • Experience with German statutory requirements and German GAAP (HGB), including preparing annual financial statements, balance sheet reconciliations and note disclosures.

  • Good understanding of German tax law, including corporate tax, trade tax, VAT declarations and withholding taxes.

  • Experience driving process improvement projects across finance.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP, and familiarity with finance tooling in a software product environment.

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting or a comparable field.

  • Experience with IFRS is an advantage.

  • Experience with intercompany transactions and transfer pricing is an advantage.

  • A professional qualification (e.g. ACCA, CIMA) is an advantage and is not required where offset by strong practical experience.

Required Skills

  • Applies mastery of German accounting principles to prepare accurate, compliant statutory financial statements.

  • Works confidently across multicultural, multi-timezone teams.

  • Steps back from operational tasks to spot inefficiencies and builds scalable solutions that work across the group.

  • Fluent German and English, written and spoken, are required. Additional languages are an advantage.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in English.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

You present our gyrocopters not only in theory but demonstrate them in flight, making the experience tangible for the customer. You are not selling a generic product, but a high-end aviation product that convinces both emotionally and technically. The key difference is that you do not just show the customer what they are buying, you let them experience it. The role combines sales of our gyrocopters with demonstration flights, is fully on-site and includes travel of approximately 20 to 40 percent. We are looking for an experienced sales professional with a strong affinity for aviation.

Join our dynamic team and play an active part in our company’s success. You can look forward to attractive terms and conditions, as well as a free lunch every day.

Tasks

  • Sales of our gyrocopters in direct customer interaction
  • Conducting demonstration flights as an integral part of the sales process
  • Advising national and international customers
  • Managing the entire sales process from first contact to closing
  • Representing our brand at customer meetings, events and demonstrations

Requirements

  • Valid ultralight pilot license including medical
  • Proven practical flight experience, ideally on comparable aircraft
  • Ability and willingness to actively fly customers and conduct demonstration flights
  • Proven track record in sales of technically complex products
  • Fluent German and English skills
  • Additional languages such as French are a plus
  • Confident and professional appearance with strong personal presence
  • Excellent communication and closing skills in an international environment

Benefits

  • Dynamic working environment with the global leader in gyroplane manufacturing.
  • Comprehensive onboarding and continuous training opportunities.
  • Supportive and international team culture.
  • Flexible working hours (flexitime) to support work–life balance.
  • Corporate fitness programme (Hansefit).
  • Employer contributions to the pension scheme.
  • Employee discounts via our corporate benefits platform.
  • Regular company events that strengthen team spirit.
  • Free daily lunch at our headquarter.
  • Overtime compensation and additional paid leave for special occasions.
  • Unique aviation experience – including a gyrocopter sightseeing flight.

Are you ready for an exciting career in aviation? Then become part of AutoGyro GmbH.

We are the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of gyroplanes, working with partners in more than 40 countries worldwide. Our headquarters and production facility are located at Hildesheim Airport. With state-of-the-art technologies, a high level of in-house manufacturing, and a clear vision for sustainable aviation, we actively shape the future of flight.

Since our founding in 1999, we have grown continuously and today employ an international team of nearly 100 qualified specialists and engineers. With a global sales network, we consistently pursue our mission: to make the fascination of flying, maximum safety, and the versatile applications of gyroplanes accessible worldwide.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Information Security Officer

Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.

The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.
  • Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products.
  • Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job.
  • Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.

AI-driven security (about half)

  • Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged.
  • Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work.
  • AI-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them.
  • Secure AI and vibe-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live.
  • AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents.

Scope

This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams.

Requirements

What you will bring

Must have

  • 10+ years in security, including 3+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100+ people.
  • Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident.
  • Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: strategy, policy, tooling, training and incident response.
  • AI-native operator. Uses AI agents daily to do the work: writing detections, reviewing code and configs, reading vendor documentation, drafting policy. Can show us the harnesses, workflows or automations you have built, and knows where AI stops and human judgment has to take over.
  • Deep, current knowledge of AI-specific risks: prompt injection, over-scoped agent permissions, credential and data exposure through AI tools, and insecure AI-generated code.
  • Hands-on with cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, SIEM, endpoint protection and email security.
  • Writes code: scripts, tooling and automation, not only vendor UIs.
  • Experience in crypto, fintech or another high-fraud industry, and deep knowledge of phishing, social engineering and impersonation attacks.
  • Can read the fine print: thorough with documentation, contracts and vendor security terms, and documents everything so nothing slips through.
  • Briefs executives in plain language, trains non-technical staff, and writes policy people follow.
  • Player-coach: comfortable spending about half your time hands-on while leading a small, fully remote team across many time zones.

Nice to have

  • Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Has secured or evaluated AI agents and LLM-based tools in production.
  • Has run a third-party risk program covering financial data aggregators or similar providers.
  • Has run a brand protection or takedown program.
  • Experience with customer-facing security features such as account-takeover defense.
  • Experience with risk quantification (FAIR or similar) and presenting to a board.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or OSCP.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Independent Contractor opportunity
  • Fully remote, globally distributed team
  • Team offsites (Dubai, Costa Rica, etc.)
  • Collaborative, forward-thinking culture that values innovation and results

jobs.description:
Head of GTM Systems & AI

Introduction to the Team & Role

 
What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
 
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
 
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
 
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
 
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.
 

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
  • Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
  • Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.
  • Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.
  • Lead and coach five senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems and web ops. Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down.
  • Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep-or-kill review, and renewals.
  • Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function.
  • Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.

jobs.title: Seller Onboarding and Support Intern
jobs.description:
Seller Onboarding and Support Intern

Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Join Back Market's dynamic Seller Success team as the driving force behind our seller ecosystem! As Europe's leading refurbished electronics marketplace, we're revolutionizing how businesses connect with millions of customers across the EU, the UK and the US.

As a Seller Activation Intern (Onboarding & Seller Support), you'll be at the heart of our growth strategy, transforming thousands of potential sellers into thriving Back Market partners. You'll master the art of business prioritization, relationship building, and data-driven decision making while gaining hands-on experience in one of Europe's fastest-growing tech companies.

This isn't just about processing applications – you'll be identifying high-potential business opportunities, strategically prioritizing sellers based on market potential, and directly impacting our marketplace expansion across Europe and the United States. At the same time, you'll play a hands-on role in improving how we work — collaborating with cross-functional teams to spot inefficiencies in our seller activation processes and helping design better, more scalable solutions.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Strategic Seller Management: Navigate through our extensive database of thousands of potential sellers, qualifying and prioritizing them based on business potential and strategic fit

  • Business Development: Provide professional consultation and support via Salesforce, guiding sellers through our comprehensive onboarding journey from initial sign-up to successful activation

  • Data-Driven Prioritization: Leverage Excel and Salesforce to analyze seller profiles, create strategic reports, and identify the most promising business opportunities

  • Projects : Take ownership of improvement projects end to end. You'll get your hands dirty identifying pain points, spotting repetitive tasks ripe for automation, and driving solutions from idea to implementation with the help of your manager — not just flagging issues, but fixing them.

  • International Impact: Communicate directly with sellers across Europe and the US, building strong professional relationships that drive business growth

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • Seeking a 6-month full-time internship (Gap Year or End of Studies welcome)

  • Fluent English - you'll be the voice of Back Market to international sellers

  • Excel proficiency including pivot tables and data analysis capabilities

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail - you'll manage high-volume, process-intensive workflows

  • Passionate about business development/sales with a keen eye for identifying opportunities

  • Structured approach to work with ability to prioritize effectively in fast-paced environments

Bonus Points:

  • French language skills

  • Salesforce experience or CRM familiarity

  • Previous commercial or e-commerce experience

  • Proactive mindset with initiative for process improvements

  • Additional European languages

Ideal Profile: We're looking for ambitious, friendly yet professional students who are genuinely excited about sales, business development, and e-commerce — and who don't just want to observe, but to build. The ideal candidate is curious about how processes work, quick to spot inefficiencies, and motivated to own solutions from start to finish. Whether you're taking a gap year or completing your studies, what matters most is your motivation, business acumen, and eagerness to make a real impact.

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months (until June 2027)

  • Schedule: Full-time (35H/week)

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: Internship agreement from your French school required

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skills fit interview with the direct manager (Reviewing the job description and missions, your CV and past experiences/projects)

  • Video-call HR Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist

  • Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Networked Systems (m/f/d)

TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Networked Systems to join the Core team within our Platform Team. Everything we build is a node: from small embedded devices to full compute systems and ground infrastructure. Together they operate as one network, in the field and over denied, degraded and intermittent links. You design how this works end to end: how nodes find and connect to each other, how trust propagates, how they communicate, and how every node exposes what the application stack needs. And you build it: the network itself, the node agent that runs on every node, the node API and the SDK.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • System design: Own the end-to-end design of how our systems connect and communicate: topology, links, transports, delivery semantics and failure behaviour. When a new requirement lands, such as operating a system beyond line of sight over LEO satellite or cellular links, you design how it works: latency budget, link selection and failover, security, and what keeps working when the link drops

  • The network: Build it: addressing plans, routing, segmentation and multi-homing across tactical radio, cellular, satcom and wired links, with dynamic routing and link selection for nodes that move and links that fail

  • Secure links: IPsec/IKEv2 or WireGuard overlays with certificate authentication from hardware-backed keys, including rekeying, NAT traversal and behaviour on link loss

  • Trust: Design how trust propagates from production to the field: device identity, certificate lifecycle, mutual authentication, authorisation tiers, revocation and signed commands that keep working without backend connectivity

  • Node agent: Design and build the agent that runs on every node and exposes identity, health, software state, connectivity and updates through one API, served locally, over the network and in compact form over constrained links. Devices too small to run it are represented through their parent node

  • Node API and SDK: One resource model for every node type, versioned and backward compatible across a fleet that never updates all at once, with SDKs generated from the contract for the languages our teams use

  • Discovery and directory: How nodes find each other with and without infrastructure, and a directory that survives restarts and shows what should exist versus what is present, at fleet scale without polling every node

  • Communication: Build on proven middleware and transports instead of reinventing them, define delivery semantics per traffic class, and engineer QoS so command and control traffic survives congestion on constrained links

  • Network as code: Configuration templated, version controlled, validated in CI and shipped as part of the system release

  • Verification: Network emulation that reproduces measured field link profiles, fault injection in CI, and network test campaigns at test ranges and flight tests with root cause from packet captures

  • Direction: Write the design documents and contracts that embedded, backend and application engineers build against, and review designs


  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years building networked or distributed systems in production, combining software engineering with hands-on network engineering, including technical ownership of a core component other teams depend on

  • Designed a networked system end to end, and can reason through a new connectivity scenario from first principles: topology, latency budget, failure modes and security

  • Expert in Rust, Go or C++, working proficiency in Python, and comfortable reading and writing C++

  • Strong networking across the stack: IP addressing and routing, UDP, TCP and QUIC internals, congestion control, multicast, NAT traversal, MTU and fragmentation; fluent with Wireshark and tcpdump

  • Expert Linux networking: iproute2, policy routing, network namespaces, VRFs, bridges, VLANs, nftables, tc and netem

  • Production experience with IPsec (strongSwan or libreswan) and WireGuard, including PKI-based authentication

  • Routing: OSPF and BGP (ideally FRRouting or BIRD), and how latency, loss and link quality shape routing and protocol design in dynamic networks

  • Applied security: PKI and certificate lifecycle, mTLS, hardware-backed keys (TPM or secure elements) and authorisation models

  • Built services that run on devices: Linux daemons, systemd, local IPC and resource-constrained environments

  • Experience with middleware such as DDS, ROS 2, Zenoh, ZeroMQ, NATS or gRPC, including discovery, flow control, serialisation and QoS

  • API and contract design consumed by many teams: schema evolution, versioning and backward compatibility

  • Written design documents that other teams implemented against

  • Willingness to travel to test sites and flight tests (around 20%)

Nice to haves

  • Systems built for denied, degraded, intermittent or limited (DDIL) connectivity: defense, robotic fleets, autonomous vehicles, space

  • Beyond-line-of-sight operation over LEO satellite, cellular or long-range radio links

  • Integration of MANET or mesh radios (e.g. Silvus, Doodle Labs, Persistent Systems) and MANET routing such as OLSR or B.A.T.M.A.N.

  • Network emulation with EMANE, CORE, ns-3 or Linux netem

  • Time synchronisation with PTP/gPTP

  • Replication and coordination (Raft, gossip, CRDTs, logical clocks)

  • Embedded ARM targets, RTOS or mixed Linux and RTOS systems

  • Tactical datalinks, defense crypto equipment or interoperability standards such as STANAG 4586

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Security Engineer

About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise.
You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem.
This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you.
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one.

What you would do

Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows.

  • Conduct hands-on penetration testing and threat modeling across our web application, APIs, control plane, and cloud environments.

  • Manage end-to-end vulnerability tracking across our codebases, software dependencies (SCA), container images, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Proactively fix security flaws by writing patches, submitting Pull Requests (PRs), or collaborating directly with product teams to guide remediation.

  • Audit and harden our cloud infrastructure (GCP, Kubernetes clusters, and networking configurations) against external and internal threats.

  • Automate security tooling into our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, dependency scanners) to catch CVEs before code reaches production.

  • Perform security code reviews and evaluate third-party dependencies, open-source integrations, and supply-chain risks.

  • Lead incident response efforts and establish continuous monitoring, detection, and mitigation strategies.

  • Own our public security posture as an open-source project: vulnerability disclosure process, CVE handling, security advisories, and the trust model of our plugin ecosystem.

Our Tech Stack

  • Security & Vulnerability Tools: Trivy, GitHub Security / Dependabot, Elastic Security

  • Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform

  • Cloud: GCP

  • Programming language: Java, Typescript, Javascript

  • Datastore: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch

  • Queuing: Redis, Kafka, AMQP

  • Monitoring & Logs: ELK, Prometheus, Grafana

  • Deployment & Repository: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Engineering, Product Security, DevSecOps, or a combined Offensive/Defensive role.

  • Strong hands-on penetration testing background, with proven ability to discover application, API, and network-level vulnerabilities.

  • A builder/fixer mindset: You don't just export scanner PDFs; you can read code, understand exploits, write fixes, or provide clear remediation steps to engineers.

  • Deep familiarity with cloud security (AWS or GCP) and containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker).

  • Experience with dependency and supply-chain security (CVE management, open-source licensing, SCA tools).

  • Fluent in English and comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote environment.

  • Adaptability to a fast-paced open-source startup environment where pragmatism and execution speed matter.

Perks & Benefits

  • Work from anywhere: We’re a remote-first company, so you can work from wherever feels like home. Plus, you’ll have access to coworking spaces worldwide if you ever need a change of scenery.

  • Health coverage: From medical support, dental, and vision, we've got you covered.

  • Home office setup on us: We’ll provide all the equipment you need to work comfortably.

     

Our Hiring Process

We aim to move quickly (2-3 weeks), but we can adjust the timeline if needed.

  • Intro call with the hiring manager (30 min)

  • Technical scenario / Practical assessment (2 hours, asynchronous homework focusing on threat assessment and remediation)

  • Team chat with one of your future colleagues (30 min)

  • Final discussion with one of our co-founders (30 min)

As a Key Account Manager Pool (KAM Pool), you play a strategic role in scaling 360Learning’s customer growth and retention engine. You will join a team focused on maximizing renewal and upsell opportunities across a large portfolio of existing customers through automation, data-driven prioritization, and scalable account management strategies.

You will manage a high-volume portfolio of customers ranging from 100 to 2,500 employees, with a focus on identifying growth opportunities, driving renewals, and increasing customer engagement at scale through automatization actions. 

At 360Learning, the KAM Pool role is a unique opportunity to also shape the overall KAM team. It combines account management, revenue generation, and operational excellence. Your mission is to build scalable motions that accelerate expansion opportunities while ensuring customers continue to realize value from the platform. Therefore, your successful automatization processes will also help shape globally the entire KAM team. 

As a transversal role, you will work closely with Client Success Partners, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and internal experts (digital pedagogy, platform structuring, IT) to deploy automated engagement strategies, optimize renewal processes, and generate upsell opportunities efficiently across your portfolio.

We are eager to retain the best talent in our teams, and we encourage internal mobility after 2–3 years of continuous success to build fulfilling career paths. This role offers strong growth opportunities toward strategic account management, revenue operations, or large account ownership positions.


Within 1 month, you will:

  • Become a Trello expert and get familiar with our product

  • Learn to navigate Convexity, our working environment

  • Meet the different teams at 360Learning

  • Understand our customer lifecycle and renewal processes 

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Take ownership of you 150+ clients portfolio of existing customers

  • Segment and prioritize accounts using scalable tiering strategies

  • Identify automation opportunities to drive renewals and upsells

  • Work closely with Client Success Partners to collect customer insights and engagement signals

  • Launch automated campaigns and structured outreach sequences

  • Prepare scalable account review frameworks to identify growth opportunities

  • Contribute to the generation of renewal and expansion pipeline across your portfolio

  • Conduct presentations and demonstrations of 360Learning when required


Within 6 months, you will:

  • Optimize renewal and upsell workflows through process improvements and automation

  • Ensure accurate reporting and forecasting with your coach and Revenue teams

  • Analyze customer usage data to proactively identify expansion opportunities and churn risks

  • Build repeatable playbooks to improve portfolio performance at scale

  • Consistently contribute to ARR growth targets through scalable account management initiatives

  • Lead business negotiations for selected opportunities


Within 12 months, you will:

  • Own and optimize the renewal strategy for your portfolio

  • Drive upsell generation through automated and data-driven engagement plans

  • Manage customer business relationships at scale while maintaining a high-quality customer experience

  • Continuously improve operational efficiency and account coverage models.

  • Become a key contributor to the company’s retention and expansion strategy

  • Exceed your targets and contribute to the evolution of scalable customer growth strategies at 360Learning.


The Skill Set:

  • 2+ years of experience in an Account Manager, BDR or sales-related function (revenue generation with a portfolio of clients)

  • Previous experiences working in the SaaS industry

  • Experience in a fast-growing environment such as start-up / scale-up, which requires agility and responsiveness

  • Active listening skills and a team player mindset

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Native French and fluent English (B2+) proficiency

  • Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR)

  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L


What we offer:

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈

  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent. 

  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠

  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍

  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆


The interview process:
  • Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Meeting with our the KAM Mid Market Coach
  • Case Study Meeting with our KAM Mid Market Coach and our VP Mid Market EMEA
  • Clarification Meeting with our VP Mid Market EMEA
  • Culture Fit Meeting with our Chief Revenue Officer
  • Ref Checks
  • Offer!
    •  ⇾ Get ready using our Knowledge Base: https://bit.ly/42H1ggC
    Who We Are
    360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.

    360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

    Learning Includes Everyone.
    In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

jobs.title: Product Manager Apprentice, Checkout
jobs.description:
Product Manager Apprentice, Checkout

Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

We are looking for a passionate and motivated Product Manager Apprentice to join our Customer Journey Team as part of the Checkout Squad.

 

This apprenticeship offers a unique opportunity to improve our shopping funnel on web and app, ensuring it’s as seamless and delightful an experience as possible. You will do so by helping to run AB tests on the user interface to uncover the most impactful features.

 

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including other Product Managers in the customer teams, Operations, Engineering, Content and Design, to drive impactful product initiatives.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Support Product Development: Participate across the product lifecycle: solution ideation, prioritization, development, and launch.

  • Handle Delivery Management: Write detailed specifications and user stories, oversee the implementation of features with IT engineers and perform quality assurance (QA).

  • Autonomously run AB tests to optimize the conversion rate from product page to checkout. Scope the test, analyse and interpret the results to uncover the best solutions.

  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with PMs, designers and marketing to challenge and prioritize feature requests, ensuring that our features are adopted seamlessly and add value to users (customers, sellers).

  • Monitor performances: Ensure each feature’s performance can be measured, help estimate the impact and follow up the results post-launch.

TOOLS YOU'LL USE: ⚒️

  • Jira & Confluence: For Delivery management and Documentation

  • Slack & Google Suite: For internal communications and meetings

  • Amplitude Experiment and Analysis: for AB test setup and data analysis

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You have an interest in product management and always put the user at the center of your thoughts.

  • You have great analytical skills and a methodological approach.

  • You possess effective and precise communication skills.

  • You are curious, proactive, resourceful, and rigorous

  • Team spirit is essential for you.

  • You are fluent in spoken and written English, as we are an international team (MANDATORY).

  • Big plus if you are already familiar with working with software developers, working across multiple teams or Agile concepts

  • Big plus if you already have any experience in UX (user experience) or AB testing

ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: Ideally for 24 months (12 months to be discussed).

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage)

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Product Sense Interview with Hiring Manager

  • Team/Cultural fit interview with 1 other member of the team

  • HR Interview with Campus Recruiter

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.title: Consultant (m/w/d) SAP Data Engineering & Databricks
jobs.description:
Consultant (m/w/d) SAP Data Engineering & Databricks

Seit über 25 Jahren verwandeln wir bei der Windhoff Group Daten in echte Geschäftschancen – von klassischer Business Intelligence bis zur KI-getriebenen Automatisierung. Dabei denken wir ganzheitlich: Wir begleiten unsere Kunden End-to-End, von der Strategie über die technische Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Ob BI-Reporting, Data Warehousing, Predictive Analytics oder KI-Lösungen – unser Anspruch ist es, aus Daten messbaren Mehrwert zu machen.

Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen an anspruchsvollen Projekten arbeiten und dich in der gesamten Data & AI-Landschaft in die Richtung weiterentwickeln, die zu dir passt.

Warum solltest du jetzt bei Windhoff starten?

Windhoff wird in der aktuellen Lünendonk®-Studie 2025/2026 explizit als einer der 20 führenden Anbieter von Data & AI Services in Deutschland genannt. Getragen wird unser Wachstum von unserem Gesellschafter Aurelius, einem globalen Private-Equity-Investor, der seit 2023 an der Windhoff Group beteiligt ist. Unser SAP-Kerngeschäft bauen wir dabei gezielt zu einer Multi-Vendor-Strategie aus – mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio sowie den Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud und AWS (u. a. Amazon Athena). Du profitierst von einem Marktumfeld, das deutlich stärker wächst als der klassische IT-Dienstleistungsmarkt – und von einem Unternehmen, das dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestaltet, statt nur zu verwalten.

Neben unserer fachlichen Expertise sind wir ein Arbeitgeber, der Vielfalt fördert und sicherstellt, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Teile
uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum
Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine
Situation im Privatleben oder besondere Bedürfnisse bei der Arbeit.

Klingt nach einem Traumjob? Dann jetzt Teil des Teams werden!

Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst die fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen unserer Kunden und setzt sie in Data-Engineering-Lösungen um, je nach Projekt auf Basis des SAP-Portfolios (SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Data Cloud) oder mit Databricks.

  • Du entwirfst skalierbare Lakehouse-Architekturen und entwickelst Datenplattformen, die zuverlässig, performant und wirtschaftlich nutzbar sind.

  • Du konzipierst und implementierst Datenmodelle sowie ETL-/ELT-Strecken, häufig in hybriden Szenarien, in denen SAP mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio und den gängigen Cloud-Plattformen zusammenspielt.

  • Du begleitest deine Projekte von der Anforderungsaufnahme über Konzeption und Implementierung bis zum Test und zur Übergabe in den Echtbetrieb beim Kunden.

  • Je nach Karrierestufe übernimmst du die Verantwortung für Teilprojekte oder ganze Projekte und für das Windhoff Projektteam. Als Lead Consultant entwickelst du außerdem deine KollegInnen fachlich weiter.

  • Du baust unseren Databricks-Fachbereich mit auf und gestaltest unsere Multi-Vendor-Strategie mit SAP als Kern aktiv mit.

  • Durch Wissenstransfer, Projektpräsentationen und interne wie externe Technologie-Events gibst du dein Wissen an KollegInnen weiter.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast relevante Berufserfahrung im SAP Data Engineering oder mit Databricks, zum Beispiel als SAP Data Engineer, SAP BW Consultant, SAP Datasphere Consultant oder Data Engineer.

  • Du kennst dich mit SAP Datasphere und dem Databricks Lakehouse aus, beherrschst SQL-Script und Python sicher und hast ETL-/ELT-Prozesse bereits erfolgreich umgesetzt.

  • Erfahrung mit Delta Lake, der Medallion-Architektur und Databricks Workflows ist von Vorteil.

  • Snowflake, Dremio sowie die Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure und AWS sind für dich kein Fremdkörper, sondern Teil einer ganzheitlichen Dateninfrastruktur.

  • Kenntnisse in ABAP und in Frontend-Tools wie SAP Analysis for Office und der SAP Analytics Cloud sind gerne gesehen und runden dein Profil ab.

  • Du arbeitest analytisch und lösungsorientiert und berätst deine Kunden technisch wie fachlich auf Augenhöhe.

  • Durch deine hohe Eigeninitiative und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit bringst du deine Ideen sowohl intern als auch bei unseren Kunden erfolgreich ein. Dabei übernimmst du gerne Verantwortung, auch über die reine Umsetzung hinaus.

  • Hierfür sind auch verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (C1-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2-Niveau) erforderlich.

Deine Perspektive

Bei uns steigst du auf der Stufe ein, die zu deiner Erfahrung passt. Von dort aus entwickelst du dich weiter:

  • Als Consultant arbeitest du in unseren Projektteams mit und verantwortest eigene Arbeitspakete. So lernst du die Data-Engineering-Welt rund um SAP und Databricks in echten Kundenprojekten kennen.

  • Als Senior Consultant verantwortest du Teilprojekte oder ganze Projekte und leitest das Windhoff Projektteam. Du bist für unsere Kunden die zentrale fachliche Ansprechperson.

  • Als Lead Consultant verantwortest du mehrere Projekte und Projektteams und entwickelst deine KollegInnen fachlich weiter. Außerdem baust du unseren Databricks-Fachbereich aktiv mit auf.

  • Als Principal übernimmst du die Verantwortung für Kundenbeziehungen und prägst unsere technologische Ausrichtung und unsere Multi-Vendor-Strategie mit.

Benefits

  • Wir stellen standortunabhängig ein. Du kannst – je nach Projekt – zu 90 % von zuhause aus oder an einem unserer Standorte arbeiten, wenn dieser für dich gut erreichbar ist. Zu gelegentlichen Kundenterminen und Teamevents startest du von deinem Lebensmittelpunkt aus, egal wo in Deutschland du wohnst.

  • Über 100 Data & Analytics Consultants zum Austausch sowie eine interne Weiterbildungsacademy

  • Langfristige Projekte mit wechselnden technologischen Herausforderungen

  • Ein festes Budget für Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsperspektiven

  • Eine gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, Überstundenausgleich sowie bis zu 40 Tagen Urlaub

  • Sowohl erstklassige Hard- und Softwareausstattung als auch Leasingangebote für Firmenwagen, IT-Hardware und Fahrräder

  • Kurze Wege im Unternehmen, ein fairer Umgang miteinander sowie unterhaltsame Teamevents

Du verfügst über die gewünschten Erfahrungen und suchst eine neue Herausforderung? Du bist flexibel, lösungsorientiert und kommunikationsfähig?

Nutze deine Chance: Wir bieten das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere.

jobs.title: Founder's Associate (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Founder's Associate (f/m/x)

About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank group, we’re adding a layer of resources and expertise to benefit from, while continuing to operate as an independent fintech with our own team, product, and start-up identity under the dwpbank umbrella.

Your Mission:

As a Founder’s Associate, you will work closely with the Founder and CEO and leadership team to help drive the company’s strategic priorities and operational execution.

In this role, you will take ownership of high-impact, cross-functional projects across the business. These may range from supporting strategic initiatives in commercial, product, and operations teams to improving internal processes, building organisational structures, and helping ensure alignment as the company scales.

This role is ideal for someone who is excited by our mission of enabling anyone to invest in capital markets. You will be close to many strategic initiatives and interact beyond lemon.markets towards our parent company, dwpbank. You will get the best of both worlds: the opportunity to work closely with experienced experts across functions while taking on meaningful ownership in a dynamic and ambitious environment.

This is going to be the ride of a lifetime for someone, who thrives in a fast-moving environment, enjoys solving ambiguous problems, and wants to gain first-hand experience in how a high-growth fintech infrastructure company is built.

 

You will:

  • Support the Founder and CEO on strategic and operational projects that drive company goals and priorities.

  • Own and lead projects with a deep focus on brokerage, custody and capital markets, this is where you will spend a significant part of your time and where domain knowledge is essential.

  • Analyse market developments, competitor dynamics, and trends across the European brokerage, wealth, and investment infrastructure landscape.

  • Take ownership of special projects that support the next stage of lemon.markets’ growth.

  • Lead and mentor the Founder’s Associate Intern team, providing structure, guidance, and prioritisation across projects while helping develop their skills and ensuring high-quality execution.

  • Contribute to refining and scaling internal processes, documentation, and operating structures across the company, especially in light of what becomes possible with AI.

  • Help develop, structure, and execute cross-functional initiatives across teams.

  • Act as a connector across the organisation by understanding team priorities, spotting gaps and blockers early, and helping drive effective cross-functional collaboration.

You’ll be successful in this role if you:

  • You have a background (bachelor and master degree) in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Computer science or a similar area.

  • You are an entrepreneurial problem solver. You strive to take ownership of the tasks you get and apply your analytical skills, structured thinking, and independent working style towards solving them.

  • You have gained 2 years or more of hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment. Ideally, you have worked in an early-stage startup, fintech, consulting, tech company or similar.

  • You bring hands-on experience in brokerage, trading, custody, or capital markets infrastructure, or a track record in strategic roles (e.g. CEO office, executive board office, in-house consulting) working on company-level topics with senior leadership.

  • You cope well with frequent change and ambiguity. Changing tasks & requirements excite you. You are able to think logically, break down complex problems and prioritise between multiple tasks on your table.

  • You are a team player. Working together as a team and sharing knowledge comes naturally to you.

  • You never let anything fall down your plate. Being on top of things is what you are known for. Having no hesitation to follow up on people until the job gets done.

  • You are ready and willing to take ownership. “This is not my job!” is not part of your vocabulary - you identify problems, take initiative to take them on, and challenge the status quo.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

 

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

jobs.description:
Werkstudent (m/w/d) Business Development Management/Marketing

Für unser Business Development Management/Marketing Team suchen wir einen engagierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d).

Die Deutsche Extrakt Kaffee GmbH zählt zu den führenden Herstellern von löslichen Kaffee- und Getränkespezialitäten. Mit Innovationskraft, technologischem Know-How und einem breiten internationalen Kundenportfolio gestalten wir täglich die Zukunft moderner Heißgetränke. Nachhaltiger Unternehmenserfolg ist für uns eine echte Teamleistung - und das macht die Zusammenarbeit in der DEK aus.

Wir bieten ein modernes Umfeld, in dem Ideen willkommen sind und Sie Ihre gestalterischen sowie organisatorischen Fähigkeiten aktiv einbringen können. Wenn Sie strukturiert arbeiten, Interesse am Business Development mitbringen und praktische Erfahrung sammeln möchten, sind Sie bei uns genau richtig.

Folgende Aufgaben erwarten Sie bei uns als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Business Development Management/Marketing:

  • Sie werden eigenverantwortlich Arbeiten, praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und sich mit neuen Ideen direkt mit einbringen.

  • Sie helfen bei der Analyse von Marktzahlen mit verschiedensten Programmen sowie der Hilfe von KI.

  • Sie unterstützen bei der Erstellung von Kalkulationen als auch der Bewertung wirtschaftlicher Potenziale.

  • Sie sind an der Organisation von Vertriebsmessen beteiligt und helfen vor Ort bei der Umsetzung.

  • Sie nutzen KI-gestützte Tools, um Markttrends, Kundenbedürfnisse und mögliche Geschäftspotenziale zu recherchieren.

  • Sie unterstützen bei der Erstellung und Aufbereitung von Angebotsunterlagen und vertriebsrelevanten Dokumenten.

  • Sie designen Projekt-Visualisierungs-Graphiken mit der Hilfe von KI.

  • Sie unterstützen mit der systematischen Analyse von Wettbewerbern.

  • Sie helfen bei Verkostungen sowie dem Musterversand.

Unser Team ergänzen Sie ideal als eingeschriebene:r Student:in eines wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen Studiengangs beispielweise Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Marketing, Business Development oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs. Sie zeichnen sich durch eine strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie analytisches Denken und Interesse an Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklung aus. Sie bringen Freude daran mit, neue Ideen zu entwickeln, praktische Erfahrungen zu sammeln und Themen nach dem Credo “Machen & Lernen” aktiv voranzutreiben. Der sichere Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint, ist ein Vorteil. Interesse an KI-gestützten Recherche- und Analysemethoden sowie erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Marketing, Vertrieb oder Business Development sind wünschenswert, jedoch keine Voraussetzung.

Unser Angebot

  • Bei uns erwartet Sie nicht nur ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz, sondern auch eine langfristige Perspektive in einem international tätigen Familienunternehmen. Sie erhalten eine attraktive Vergütung, ergänzt durch Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld sowie regelmäßige Gehaltsanpassungen.

  • Wir möchten, dass Sie sich bei uns langfristig wohlfühlen und Ihre Arbeit flexibel gestalten können. Deshalb bieten wir Ihnen moderne Arbeitsbedingungen mit Gleitzeit, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit mobil zu arbeiten.

  • Wir bieten Ihnen ein attraktives Vergütungsmodell.

  • Gemeinsam wachsen: Wir fördern Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und externe Qualifizierungsangebote. Bei uns erhalten Sie Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung für spannende Projekte und Produkte zu übernehmen.

  • Karriere mit Geschmack: Sie erhalten monatliche Freikontingente, damit Sie auch nach der Arbeit erstklassigen Kaffee, Cappuccino und Trinkschokoladen genießen können.

  • Damit nicht nur unsere Produkte überzeugen, sondern auch Ihr Arbeitsalltag angenehm bleibt, wird in unserer betriebseigenen Kantine täglich frisch gekocht.

  • Dank unserer Kooperation mit dem Fürstenberg Institut erhalten Sie und Ihre Familienangehörigen Zugang zu professioneller und vertraulicher Beratung – bei beruflichen, privaten oder familiären Themen.

  • Unsere Mitarbeitenden liegen uns am Herzen. Neben den vielfältigen Angeboten gehören auch kleine Aufmerksamkeiten zu Geburtstagen, Ostern, Nikolaus oder Weihnachten bei uns einfach dazu.

     

Dürfen wir uns kurz vorstellen?

Familiär. International. Langfristig.
