jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance

Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk.

Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn.

Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig.

Wat ga je doen?

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

  • Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value.

  • Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

  • Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

  • Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen

Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan:

  • KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen.

  • Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam.

  • Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit.

  • Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security.

  • Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.


Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

  • Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

  • Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. 

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team;

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

  • Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value.

  • Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

  • Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

  • Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

AI op het snijvlak van commerce, data en operatie

Je begrijpt hoe productdata, assortiment, orderstromen, fulfilment, klantenservice en commerciële sturing samenkomen. Denk aan:

  • Agents die productcontent voor duizenden artikelen verrijken en controleren.

  • Een klantenservicetoepassing die retouren en leveringsvragen niet alleen beantwoordt, maar ook de vervolgstappen voorbereidt.

  • Vraagvoorspellingen waar categoriemanagers hun beslissingen op durven te baseren.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in retail of e-commerce: je kent de processen, data en platformen van binnenuit.

  • Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security.

  • Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met PIM, OMS, ERP of commerceplatformen, en met klassieke ML zoals vraagvoorspelling.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

  • Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

  • Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. 

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team;

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

jobs.title: Senior Projectleider Beschermd Wonen & Maatschappelijke Opvang | Gemeente Den Haag
jobs.description:
Senior Projectleider Beschermd Wonen & Maatschappelijke Opvang | Gemeente Den Haag

Omschrijving

Wij zijn voor de Gemeente Den Haag op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Projectleider Beschermd Wonen en Maatschappelijke Opvang. In deze opdracht speel je een sleutelrol in de ontwikkeling, inrichting en implementatie van het regionale Samenwerkingsplatform Maatschappelijke Opvang & Beschermd Wonen (MO/BW) voor de H5-regio.

Je vertaalt een bestaand advies naar een uitvoerbaar samenwerkingsmodel en zorgt ervoor dat het platform operationeel is bij de start van de nieuwe contractperiode. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met beleidsafdelingen, inkoop, privacy, informatiemanagement, zorgaanbieders, GGZ-instellingen, verslavingszorg, woningcorporaties en ICT-partijen.

Het doel is een duurzaam en breed gedragen samenwerkingsplatform te realiseren waarmee gemeenten en aanbieders gezamenlijk sturen op passende plaatsingen, capaciteitsmanagement, transformatieopgaven binnen het sociaal domein en het voorkomen van escalaties.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je vertaalt het conceptadvies naar een uitvoerbaar ontwerp voor het regionale Samenwerkingsplatform Maatschappelijke Opvang en Beschermd Wonen (MO/BW).

  • Je geeft inhoudelijk en organisatorisch leiding aan de verdere ontwikkeling, inrichting en implementatie van het platform.

  • Je werkt de platformfuncties verder uit op het gebied van matching en plaatsing, monitoring en capaciteitssturing, transformatieopgaven en de-escalatie.

  • Je ontwikkelt de governance-structuur en werkt rollen, verantwoordelijkheden, mandaten en besluitvormingsprocessen uit.

  • Je begeleidt bestuurlijke en tactische overleggen en creëert draagvlak bij gemeenten, aanbieders en ketenpartners.

  • Je stelt een samenwerkingsovereenkomst of convenant op en borgt de regionale samenwerking.

  • Je ontwikkelt werkprocessen, overlegstructuren, escalatieprocedures en monitoringskaders.

  • Je stelt functionele eisen op voor het digitale informatiesysteem en zorgt voor aansluiting op AVG-, informatiebeveiligings- en gemeentelijke eisen.

  • Je verbindt gebruikers, informatievoorziening en ICT-partijen bij de ontwikkeling van het systeem.

  • Je ondersteunt de aanbesteding en bewaakt de samenhang tussen de platformontwikkeling en het inkooptraject.

  • Je stelt implementatie-, communicatie- en participatieplannen op en begeleidt de ingebruikname van het platform.

  • Je organiseert bestuurlijke besluitvorming en verzorgt de overdracht naar de lijnorganisatie.


Wat vragen wij?

  • Je beschikt over academisch werk- en denkniveau.

  • Je hebt minimaal 10 jaar ervaring als projectleider of programmamanager binnen het sociaal domein.

  • Je hebt ervaring met maatschappelijke opvang, beschermd wonen of complexe zorgketens.

  • Je hebt ervaring met regionale samenwerking tussen gemeenten, zorgaanbieders en andere ketenpartners.

  • Je hebt ervaring met governancevraagstukken, netwerksturing en bestuurlijke besluitvorming.

  • Je hebt kennis van digitalisering, gegevensuitwisseling, informatiemanagement en de implementatie van informatiesystemen.

  • Je hebt ervaring met aanbestedingen of contractmanagement binnen het sociaal domein.

  • Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en weet draagvlak te creëren binnen complexe samenwerkingsverbanden.

  • Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve, analytische en organisatorische vaardigheden.

  • Je vertaalt strategische vraagstukken naar concrete resultaten en realiseert implementaties in complexe bestuurlijke omgevingen.

Informatie 

Start: 4 januari 2027

Aantal uur: 20 tot 36 uur per week

Lengte opdracht: 6 maanden met optie tot verlenging

Locatie: Den Haag

Vorm: Detachering (niet geschikt voor ZZP)

Geïnteresseerd?

Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor woensdag 11 november 12:00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht.

Contact

Voor meer informatie over deze opdracht kunt u contact opnemen met Edgar Groenendijk, Managing Consultant Interim Management, 06 12 61 24 04,

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager (South Dakota)
jobs.description:
Regional Sales Manager (South Dakota)

About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

As a Regional Sales Manager at Halter, you will lead a team of Territory Managers on the front lines of transforming livestock management across the U.S. This is a deeply hands-on role: you’ll spend most of your time in the field coaching reps, joining customer conversations, and removing barriers to their success.

You’ll shape regional performance, uphold rigorous pipeline and Salesforce standards, and ensure your team executes with consistency and excellence. We’re looking for a leader who brings energy, high standards, and a strong sense of culture. Someone who cares about people, thrives in fast growth, and can operate equally well in strategy discussions and day-to-day execution.

This role can be based anywhere in South Dakota. Frequent travel is required as apart of this position.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach & develop Territory Managers through frequent in-field work (~60% travel), ongoing feedback, role-plays, and hands-on sales training to ensure strong execution and skill development.

  • Own regional revenue performance by driving consistent activity, supporting both new sales and account expansion, and ensuring TMs meet input and output targets.

  • Maintain world-class Salesforce hygiene & forecasting, reviewing pipelines weekly, ensuring accurate data, and acting as deal support on structure, escalations, and critical opportunities.

  • Serve as the regional voice - surfacing customer insights, product feedback, and operational issues to Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer teams, and broader leadership.

  • Localize national strategy into regional execution plans, run lightweight team rhythms (1:1s, check-ins), and align closely with U.S. commercial leadership on performance and priorities.

  • Recruit and develop high-performing talent, helping scale Territory Manager teams as Halter grows rapidly across the U.S.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong Frontline Sales Leadership: Experience leading and developing field sales reps, ideally in high-growth or high-velocity environments, with a track record of coaching reps to consistently improve performance.

  • Hands-On, Field-First Mindset: Comfortable spending the majority of your time on the road - joining customer visits, modeling best practices, and staying deeply connected to real-world customer challenges.

  • Expertise in Sales Process & Methodology: Proficiency in modern sales practices (e.g., consultative/challenger sales models, role-plays, discovery techniques) and the ability to coach Territory Managers to master them.

  • Pipeline, Salesforce, & Forecasting Discipline: Strong operational rigor with CRM hygiene, pipeline management, input metrics, and forecasting accuracy - especially important in a hardware + software environment.

  • Direct, Supportive People Leadership: A leadership style built on clarity, accountability, empathy, and high support - someone who cares deeply, sets high expectations, and builds strong team culture.

  • Comfort With Ambiguity & Fast Growth: Thrives in dynamic, evolving environments; adaptable, resourceful, and motivated by building systems, processes, and habits in a rapidly scaling U.S. business.

Our Benefits

  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): Own a part of Halter and share in our growth and success

  • 401(k): 100% match on the first 3% contributed, plus 50% match on the next 2% (up to a 4% employer match), with immediate vesting

  • Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first day of the month after you join (with most premiums covered, including 100% of employee-only health premiums on select plans)

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) & paid wellness leave: Access confidential support through JustWorks plus 3 paid wellness days per year

  • Personal growth fund: $750 USD per year to support learning, development, or personal growth goals

  • Unlimited PTO: Take time off when you need it—no accrual required, available from day one

  • Parental leave: 16 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks paid leave for non-birthing parents

  • Onboarding travel to New Zealand: Fly to NZ for onboarding at Halter HQ in Auckland—meet the team, visit a test farm, and immerse yourself in all things Halter

The annual OTE salary range for this role is $200,000 - $225,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Halter and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Full-Time USA

jobs.description:
Safety Engineer Luft- und Raumfahrt (m/w/d)

Safety Engineer Luft- und Raumfahrt (m/w/d) - Vollzeit | Bonn

Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Copy Editor English

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

Your work will shape the language that medical students, clinicians, and educators rely on, from exam prep to the point of care. You’ll edit articles and Qbanks for different markets and work side by side with our medical editors. Together, you’ll keep our content clear, correct, and consistent as it grows. You’ll also build and test AI tools and prompts that raise the language quality of everything we publish. If you love both the art of language and the language of medicine, we’d be delighted to meet you.

You will:

  • Copyedit AMBOSS articles following our in-house style guide (based on the AMA Manual of Style), keeping content clear, correct, concise, and consistent

  • Edit Qbanks tailored to specific markets around the world

  • Work closely with our medical editors to discuss language issues, streamline content, and reach compromises when views differ

  • Collaborate with the multimedia, user experience, paid courses, and marketing teams to ensure high-quality output and consistency across the brand

  • Create, test, and refine AI tools and prompts that improve the language quality of our content

  • Critically evaluate and refine AI-assisted content to ensure linguistic accuracy, clarity, consistency, and adherence to editorial standards

  • Support medical editors with language questions and explain our conventions and the reasoning behind them, both day-to-day and through workshops and other teaching formats

  • Help shape the language of our products and keep up to date with the latest developments in medical language

  • Maintain our in-house guides, flag when a new convention is needed, and refine editorial processes to work more efficiently

You bring:

  • Fluency in English (C2 level) and a deep interest in its intricacies

  • Substantial editing experience (scientific or medical editing is a plus) and a good grasp of medical terminology

  • Experience editing according to a style guide, with accuracy and attention to detail

  • Strong research skills, using reliable sources to check terminology and decide how best to convey information to users

jobs.title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
jobs.description:
Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game

We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Enterprise Sales Director, Benelux

About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you'll do

  • Prospecting & lead generation: Identify and target potential customers through research, networking, and cold calling. Build new relationships with our enterprise customers and prospects to drive revenue, pipeline, and deployment capacity.

  • Manage relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders with our largest customers. Serve as their primary point of contact and exceed their expectations.

  • Negotiating & closing complex deal cycles: Lead negotiations with existing and prospective customers, addressing objections and closing deals. Navigate contracts and agreements quickly and effectively, working closely with legal and finance stakeholders.

  • Sales strategy & planning: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets. Craft tailored sales presentations and proposals that meet our enterprise customers needs. Collaborate with our marketing team to implement effective sales campaigns and presentations.

  • Help define our sales motion: You'll be the first Sales person in region, and your work will directly impact how our GTM function operates and succeeds in the Benelux.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with our broader GTM team, as well as our product, technical and operations orgs to deliver our industry-leading product.

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

  • Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities. Professional fluency in Dutch and English.

  • Enterprise experience: Experience managing a $1M+ quota, and running end-to-end complex deals.

  • Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Prospecting & lead generation: Proven track record of identifying and targeting potential enterprise clients through research, networking, and cold calling.

Even better...

  • Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.

  • Experience building GTM strategies: Building sales teams and sales motions from scratch, or from early stage growth.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

jobs.title: Collections Manager
jobs.description:
Collections Manager

Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

Harness is seeking a Collections Manager to own accounts receivable and cash collections for our fast-growing SaaS business, as part of the Revenue Accounting team. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who drives cash in, reduces days sales outstanding, and builds the collections infrastructure to scale with the business.

The ideal candidate is an operator who works independently, maintains audit-ready processes, and acts as the go-to expert and escalation point for collections across Finance, Sales, Legal, and DealOps. You will partner closely with the billing team to keep invoicing accurate, but your focus is the full collections lifecycle: from credit review through cash application, dispute resolution, and reporting.

About the role

Collections & AR Lifecycle Management

  • End-to-end ownership: Own the AR aging cycle across the customer base; monitor outstanding balances, prioritize outreach, and drive timely collection of past-due accounts.
  • Strategic collections: Develop tailored collection strategies for key and high-risk accounts, including executive-level escalations and payment plan negotiations.
  • Forecasting: Partner with Finance to forecast cash receipts and flag collection risk, reserves, and write-off candidates ahead of period close.
  • Escalation and mentorship: Serve as the escalation point and subject matter expert for collections; coach team members on best practices and set outreach cadences and standards.

Cash Application & Reconciliation

  • Manage the end-to-end cash application process, ensuring timely and accurate posting of bank deposits, wire transfers, ACH, and credit card payments to the subledger.
  • Reconcile unapplied cash and clear exceptions, working with Treasury and Accounting to keep the AR subledger tied to the general ledger.

Credit Risk Assessment

  • Perform credit reviews for new customers and establish and monitor credit limits to mitigate financial risk.
  • Identify accounts with deteriorating payment behavior and recommend holds, terms changes, or other risk actions.

Dispute & Deduction Management

  • Resolve payment disputes, credit memos, and refund requests within defined SLAs.
  • Partner with Legal and DealOps on complex contract interpretations, and with Sales on customer relationship strategy for sensitive accounts.
  • Track root causes of disputes and feed them back to billing and sales operations to prevent repeat issues.

Metrics & Reporting

  • Develop and maintain AR dashboards that track KPIs including DSO, collection effectiveness index, past-due percentage, aging trends, and unapplied cash.
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on collections performance to Revenue Accounting and Finance leadership.

Billing Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with the billing team to resolve invoice errors, contract mismatches, and amendments that delay payment; escalate systemic billing issues with the right context and urgency.
  • Build strong partnerships with DealOps, Sales, Legal, IT, and Finance, and communicate clearly with leadership on collections risk and cash performance.
  • Maintain working knowledge of NetSuite and Salesforce-to-NetSuite data flows as they relate to invoicing, payment terms, and customer records.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze collections and cash application workflows to find bottlenecks, and implement scalable, automated solutions that reduce manual effort.
  • Lead initiatives with IT and Sales Operations to streamline the quote-to-cash process, including dunning, payment reminders, and customer self-service payment options.
  • Create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all collections, cash application, and credit tasks, and keep them current as processes evolve.

Month-End Close & Compliance

  • Complete all collections and AR tasks on schedule, including journal entries for adjustments, reserves, and write-offs, and support flux analysis on AR balances.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and support external audit requests, including PBC samples and process walkthroughs.
  • Ensure collections practices comply with ASC 606, SOX controls, and internal credit and revenue recognition policies.

About You

  • 5–7 years of collections, accounts receivable, or revenue accounting experience in a high-growth SaaS or software company, with a proven record of reducing DSO and past-due balances.
  • Experience owning collections strategy for enterprise B2B accounts, including negotiating with customer finance and procurement teams and handling executive escalations.
  • Strong working experience with NetSuite (AR, cash application, and customer records) and Salesforce-to-NetSuite data flows.
  • Advanced Excel/Sheets skills, including XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and managing large data sets for reconciliation and aging analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience identifying process gaps and implementing workflow improvements or automation.
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills; comfortable engaging with Sales, Legal, and Finance leadership.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and guide or mentor others.

Preferred

  • Experience with usage-based or consumption billing models.
  • Exposure to a SOX controls environment and internal audit processes at publicly traded companies.
  • Experience with credit risk assessment and credit limit management for B2B customers.
  • Experience with collections automation or AR tools and building AR dashboards.

Work Location

  • Remote within the U.S. Occasional travel could be required.

What you will have at Harness

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Flexible Time Off and Parental Leave
  • Monthly, quarterly, and annual social and team building events
  • Monthly internet reimbursement

The anticipated base salary range for this position is between $121,000 and $148,000 annually. Salary is determined by a combination of factors including location, level, relevant experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. The compensation package for this position may also include equity, and benefits. More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.harness.io/company/careers.

Pay transparency

$100,000—$148,000 USD

Harness in the news:

  • Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
  • Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
  • How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
  • Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
  • Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

jobs.description:
Group Product Manager, AI-Native Data Warehouse

About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

We are looking for a highly experienced and autonomous Group Product Manager to own our newest product (Dex), an intelligent AI-native data warehouse for private markets. This is a flagship zero-to-one role where you will define the vision and multi-year strategy for one of the most consequential product areas at Juniper Square, operate as the lead product voice, and drive the data foundation that powers both our external products and our internal fund administration operations.

This product is how Juniper Square turns the fragmented, document-heavy reality of private markets data into a clean, structured, trustworthy foundation. It touches some of the hardest problems in the domain: ingesting and parsing ware documents and data feeds from dozens of source systems, classifying and extracting structured data, mapping and enriching it against a private-markets data model, validating it to a standard our customers can rely on, and distributing it to the apps, agents, and people who depend on it. You will own this entire pipeline and define how this product serves as the data backbone for Juniper Square’s apps, AI agents, and managed services.

AI fluency is a baseline expectation. PMs at this level should be comfortable using the full range of modern tools (e.g. LLMs, Cursor, Claude) to move faster and make sharper decisions. That might mean orchestrating AI agents to synthesize customer feedback into working hypotheses, building functional prototypes before writing requirements, or using coding agents to submit pull requests for engineering. The expectation is sound judgment about what will get to the best outcome for the customer and the team.

This role would benefit from in-person collaboration in San Francisco, where many of our product management, design, and engineering personnel are based, although we also welcome exceptional candidates from elsewhere in the United States and Canada.

What you’ll do

  • Take a new product zero-to-one: Transform Dex from an idea into a reality. Bring the entrepreneurial craft, energy, and spirit that a new product requires.

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap: Define the multi-year vision and strategy for Dex as both an external product and the internal backbone for Juniper Square’s fund administration operations. Sequence the roadmap optimally for Dex to scale across new use cases and customer profiles.

  • Talk to customers: Spend meaningful time with the GPs who depend on clean, aggregated data, as well as with our internal fund administration team. Use customer insights to challenge and ultimately sharpen strategic direction.

  • Lead cross-functionally: Partner with engineering, design, fund administration, customer success, sales, forward-deployed AI development teams, and executive stakeholders to align on strategy and ensure execution serves both the business and the customer. Dex is a shared foundation, so alignment across stakeholder groups is critical.

  • Ship end-to-end: Take problems from discovery through delivery. Plan projects, define requirements, and motivate those building solutions with an understanding of the "why" and the "what" to inspire their ownership of the "how." Work with our go-to-market and fund administration teams to drive adoption of new capabilities and ultimately realize their business value.

  • Harness the power of AI: Dex enables customers to use AI to derive value from previously scattered and unstructured data. Own the product direction for AI-powered capabilities across the pipeline - agentic document ingestion, automated classification and extraction, intelligent mapping and enrichment, human-in-the-loop review, search and retrieval, and AI-driven data insights.

  • Simplify complexity: Private markets data is genuinely hard - inconsistent formats across administrators, unstructured documents, complex fund structures, and a high bar for accuracy because everything downstream depends on it. Take on the hardest problems in the domain and deliver solutions that feel simple.

  • Be a leader: Set direction across multiple workstreams and engineering teams. Provide mentorship and product leadership to other PMs working in and adjacent to the domain, and raise the bar for product craft across the organization.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management experience in B2B or Enterprise SaaS, with a significant portfolio of shipped work across the full development lifecycle.

  • Proven experience owning a complex product area end-to-end, from strategy and roadmap through execution and iteration, ideally in a zero-to-one context.

  • Background in data warehousing, data modeling, document ingestion and extraction, ETL/ELT pipelines, data quality and validation.

  • Experience building agentic workflows or production LLM features with real evaluation and monitoring discipline.

  • Fluency with LLMs and common AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor) - you should be able to run your own prototypes and use AI to get work done faster than a traditional PM workflow would allow.

  • Strong communication skills, written and verbal, with the ability to articulate product decisions clearly to engineers, designers, executives, and customers alike.

  • Track record of leading through influence - ideally mentoring or managing other product managers - and setting strategy that multiple teams execute against.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. salary range for this role is $230,000 - $300,000 USD and the Canadian salary range is $200,000 - $250,000 CAD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

  • Life insurance

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • Retirement saving plans

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Engineer, Emerging Technologies
jobs.description:
Principal Solutions Engineer, Emerging Technologies

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Principal Solutions Engineer, Acceleration, you’ll help define how 1Password brings emerging technologies to market. Working across Product Management, Product Marketing, Enablement, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and strategic customers, you’ll validate new capabilities, shape product direction through field feedback, and turn what works into repeatable customer-facing motions.

Your work will help customers adopt innovations that strengthen secure access for people, machines, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents while advancing 1Password’s mission to make secure access simpler. Reporting to the Vice President, Global Solutions Engineering, this remote role is open to candidates in the United States or Canada and may involve up to 30% travel.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

  • 8+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles within enterprise Business-to-Business Software as a Service (B2B SaaS), including leading initiatives beyond an individual sales territory.

  • A track record of translating emerging technologies into customer value, repeatable field motions, and clear recommendations that shape product or go-to-market direction.

  • Experience partnering effectively with Product Management, Engineering, Product Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to validate capabilities and incorporate customer feedback.

  • Strong executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence audiences ranging from technical practitioners to senior executives, analysts, and strategic partners.

  • Deep knowledge of modern identity architectures and developer or AI-powered workflows, including Open Authorization (OAuth), OpenID Connect (OIDC), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), application programming interfaces (APIs), Model Context Protocol (MCP), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), infrastructure automation, AI agents, and modern cloud platforms.

  • Experience with Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain, Champion, and Competition (MEDDPICC), or a similar enterprise sales methodology, along with the ability to work autonomously and influence without direct authority.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with private previews, beta programs, or early-stage products; technical enablement and customer-facing content; or domains such as Artificial Intelligence Security (AI Security), Developer Security, Privileged Access, Software as a Service (SaaS) Manager, or Unified Access Management is preferred.

  • A track record of public speaking, technical writing, podcasts, analyst engagements, or other forms of technical thought leadership is also valued.

What you can expect:

  • Lead technical validation for emerging products, strategic initiatives, and incubating technologies from early development through general availability.

  • Partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, and Engineering to shape product direction and turn field feedback into actionable recommendations.

  • Build repeatable discovery frameworks, demonstrations, technical messaging, reference architectures, and implementation guidance for the global Solutions Engineering organization.

  • Design and deliver technical enablement, including workshops, labs, certifications, and playbooks that help Solutions Engineers confidently support new capabilities.

  • Lead strategic customer engagements, private previews, beta programs, and early-adopter initiatives, providing executive-level technical guidance and influencing customer outcomes.

  • Identify emerging market opportunities and represent 1Password through executive briefings, conferences, webinars, podcasts, customer events, and industry content.

  • Mentor Solutions Engineers and lead cross-functional initiatives that accelerate adoption, strengthen technical excellence, and scale what works across the organization.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $171,000 USD and $248,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $170,000 CAD and $247,000 CAD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

🩺 Competitive health benefits

Growth and future

Community

🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. jobs.title: Account Executive, Private Equity Real Estate
jobs.description:
Account Executive, Private Equity Real Estate

About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

Juniper Square is hiring an Account Executive to join our Real Assets Sales team, partnering with investment managers across commercial real estate and broader real assets. As a Real Assets Account Executive, you’ll lead the full sales cycle and play a key role in driving revenue growth. Our customers and prospects will look to you as a trusted advisor who can thoughtfully map Juniper Square’s solutions to their business needs.

In this role, you will identify and develop new opportunities, build strong and lasting relationships, guide prospects through a thorough evaluation process, and collaborate cross-functionally to ensure deal success. You’ll forecast with precision, manage a healthy pipeline, and consistently meet or exceed revenue targets.

You’ll be joining a team-oriented, high-performing group of sellers who are deeply invested in understanding our prospects, our clients, and the PERE ecosystem. We operate with a blend of SaaS and professional-services sales motions, and our team’s diverse experience is a key driver of our continued success.

What you’ll do

  • Engage directly with prospective Private Equity Real Estate and Real Assets firms to sell fund administration and software solutions.

  • Acquire new clients and develop ongoing account strategies to drive expansion and revenue growth within existing relationships.

  • Partner closely with Sales Development, Fund Solutions, and Solutions Engineering teams to originate, manage, and close new business.

  • Deliver a best-in-class buying experience by understanding customer needs and guiding them through an effective evaluation process.

  • Build consensus and executive alignment across stakeholders to drive mutually beneficial outcomes.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key external partners—CPA firms, banks, law firms, and other industry stakeholders.

  • Contribute to refining and optimizing our go-to-market approach as we deepen our understanding of product-market fit.

  • Represent Juniper Square at in-person and virtual industry events

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of B2B, full-cycle, quota-carrying sales experience.

  • Experience selling fund administration services, FinTech solutions, SaaS products, or comparable offerings.

  • Knowledge of or experience within the CRE ecosystem is a strong preference

  • Strong curiosity and eagerness to deeply understand our market and customer needs.

  • Demonstrated integrity, ethics, and alignment with company values.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to a range of audiences.

  • Ability to prioritize outcomes that drive both commercial success and customer value.

  • Proficiency with sales tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, and Gong.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to lead and coordinate across multiple stakeholders.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, commission, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary target for this role is $145,000. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability coverage

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Unlimited vacation in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • 401k retirement savings plan

  • Healthcare FSA and commuter benefits programs

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

  • Annual professional development stipend

Full-Time Canada, USA
